repos_data.description: An MCP server for safer coding agents: skill routing, C4 workflow gates, memory checks, and verification before completion.

repo_meta_data.description: A sub-harness (both an MCP server and an MCP client). Delegates documentation and source code analysis, as well as interactions with related context-providing MCP servers, to a local or inexpensive OpenAI-compatible LLM. Drastically reduces token usage and context size for coding agents on the top-tier LLM.
